_comment: Grandfathered debt for lint-section-id.mjs (brikdesigns#942). Each entry is
the count of top-level <section>s in that file that still lack a stable
identifier (data-section / aria-labelledby). The gate is a ratchet: a new
un-identified section pushes a file above its count and FAILS; converting a
section below the count also FAILS until you lower the number here. New files
default to 0 — they must ship identified. Backfill going-forward, one file at
a time, dropping its count to 0 and removing the entry. Convention:
